headline: Triple Plan for the Economy Announced by Pierrakakis: Tax Relief, Primary Residence and New Investments
summary: Finance Minister Kostis Pierrakakis announced a three-part plan for the economy covering tax relief, primary residence measures and new investments. He described September as a month of significant initiatives.
why: The Greek finance ministry sets tax and fiscal policy, which shapes household demand, public finances and investor sentiment in Greece.
